sites.name: Vanderkloof Dam reservoir raster lows
sites.basis: Repair implausible elevation samples on the retained field beside the upstream shore.

sites.name: Vanderkloof Dam south bank raster lows
sites.basis: Repair isolated invalid elevations around the southern chute foot and neighboring slope.

sites.name: Vanderkloof Dam north crest approach
sites.basis: Match the rendered service road and ground to the north end of the 1180 m crest.

sites.name: Vanderkloof Dam south crest approach
sites.basis: Match the rendered service road and ground to the south end of the 1180 m crest.

sites.name: Vanderkloof Dam radial chute apron
sites.basis: Fit the narrow excavated apron beneath the four radial chutes at their outlets. Blend into the retained gorge shoulder.

sites.name: Vanderkloof Dam south outlet shore
sites.basis: Fit the low terrace in front of the two south outlet recesses and leave the outer bank in place.

sites.name: Vanderkloof Dam inner gorge shoulder
sites.basis: Blend the narrow bank between the outlet terrace and lower chute apron. Retain the outer slopes and access roads.

waterStages.name: Vanderkloof Reservoir
waterStages.basis: Representative stage below the crest and at the documented overflow sill.

waterStages.name: Orange River below Vanderkloof Dam
waterStages.basis: Representative downstream level shown in the retained dam photos and consistent with the standard raster.

waterStages.name: Vanderkloof Orange River duplicate centerline
waterStages.basis: The retained river polygon depicts the channel below the dam.

waterStageNotes: The retained reservoir and downstream Orange River polygons use representative stages of 1170.5 m and 1106 m.
